images.title: 19 in base 8
images.purpose: Shows 19 grouped into eights: two groups of 8 and 3 left over, written 23 in base 8.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. A cluster of dots on the left grouped by rings, an arrow, and two place boxes on the right.
images.exact_structure: Left: exactly 19 dots: two rings in teal (#0072B2) each holding exactly 8 dots in two rows of 4, and exactly 3 loose dots in amber (#E69F00). Above the dots: 19. One dark arrow pointing right. Right: two boxes headed 8s and 1s, holding 2 in teal and 3 in amber. Above the boxes: base 8. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: In base 8, group into eights: 19 is two 8s and 3, written 23.
images.description: Shows 19 grouped into eights: two groups of 8 and 3 left over, written 23 in base 8.
images.context: Also 19 is 34 in base 5 and 10011 in base 2.

image_decisions.why: Writing in another base means regrouping by a different size, which the rings make visible.
